description: Free EU Digital Product Passport readiness check. Returns a 0-100 score, gaps, and the dated obligation for the product category (battery passport is law from 18 Feb 2027; other categories are ESPR targets). Not legal advice.

category.description: battery_passport: EV, LMT (e-bike, e-scooter) or industrial battery over 2 kWh; battery_other: Other battery (portable, SLI, industrial up to 2 kWh); textiles: Textiles, apparel or footwear; iron_steel: Iron and steel; aluminium: Aluminium; tyres: Tyres; furniture: Furniture; mattresses: Mattresses; electronics: Electronics and ICT; toys: Toys; construction: Construction products; detergents: Detergents and cleaning products; other: Something else

data_host.description: You have a public web location where product data could be published behind a QR code.

data_owner.description: A named person owns product compliance data.

footprint.description: You have carbon or environmental footprint data for the product.

market_role.description: You know who places the product on the EU market (you, an importer or an EU representative).

sells_in_eu.description: Sold into the EU directly or via an importer. Default true.

supplier_data.description: You can get material and substance data from your suppliers.

unique_id.description: Each product (or model or batch) has a unique identifier, such as a GS1 GTIN with serial.

name: dpp_readiness_check
